column3: “Leaders” resolves shepherds; “useless idols” specifies what does not profit.
“Useless idols” specifies what does not profit.
“Born into slavery” explains one born in the household.
“Lie in ruins” stands for burned cities.
Shaving renders the grazing of the scalp.
“Nile” and “Euphrates” identify Shihor and the River.
“You broke” stands for “I broke”; refusing to serve replaces refusing to transgress.
“Very best seed” renders wholly reliable seed.
“Galloping here and there” replaces intertwining her paths.
The opening command is recast as what should have been done; “gods” and “must” are supplied.
